summary: Pin is in bush; the big gardens visitor car park lies just east.
reasons: Ring in dense bush, no track
Large sealed visitor car park 41 m away
Busy by day, among gardens buildings

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings mapped or visible. The car park backs onto bush on its west side, but gardens buildings, the planetarium and a main road are all within about 80 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with many marked bays, mapped access yes, no fee. The ring itself has no track.
drivers.traffic: Busy visitor and through traffic by day; the main road lies about 60 m north.
drivers.convention: Dozens of cars parked; a van would blend in by day. Nothing suggests overnight stays.

flags: Slope figure is for the ring (about 7% mean, max 14%); car park not sampled
Gardens car park may be gated, lit or patrolled after hours
Noise from the main road and visitor traffic
Maintenance depot and staff buildings within 85 m
sun_shade: Open car park in full sun, with shade from the bush on the west side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Signs on site, such as time limits

best_section.where: Edge of the large sealed visitor car park east of the ring, backing onto the bush
